questions.title: If the Boston Celtics agree to trade Jaylen Brown by July 31, 2026, which NBA team will be his destination?
questions.background: Jaylen Brown plays for the Boston Celtics and was named the 2024 NBA Finals MVP.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reporting by ESPN or The Associated Press identifying an agreed trade involving Jaylen Brown between June 1 and July 31, 2026.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the team designated to receive Brown under the first such publicly reported agreement. An agreement counts even if league approval or completion remains pending.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the NBA team.
questions.accepted_format: The full name of the NBA team.

questions.title: Which NBA team will sign Trey Alexander to a two-way contract in the first two weeks of July 2026?
questions.background: A two-way contract allows a player to play for both an NBA team and its G League affiliate.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: as confirmed by a team announcement or contemporaneous sports reporting
  • Resolution Date: Resolve to the NBA team that signs Trey Alexander to a two-way contract between July 1 and July 14, 2026, inclusive
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the team's full name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the team's full name.

questions.title: Which ownership group will receive NFL owners' approval to buy the Seattle Seahawks in 2026?
questions.background: The Seattle Seahawks are owned by Paul Allen's estate. Allen's will calls for the team to be sold and the assets distributed to charities.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official NFL announcement or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the purchasing group approved by NFL owners.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the purchasing ownership group in the first sale of the Seattle Seahawks formally approved by NFL owners during 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.
questions.accepted_format: The name of the purchasing group or the family leading it.

questions.title: Who will win the Most Valuable Player award at the 2026 MLB All-Star Game?
questions.background: The MLB All-Star Game is an annual exhibition between the American League and National League. Its Most Valuable Player award recognizes an individual player's performance in the game.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: MLB's official announcement of the 2026 All-Star Game MVP, corroborated by contemporaneous reputable news reporting.
  • Resolution Timing: The question resolves when the MVP recipient is publicly announced following the 2026 All-Star Game, expected in July 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the player awarded the game's MVP honor.
questions.accepted_format: The full name of the player awarded the game's MVP honor.

questions.title: Who will lead the 2026 Open Championship after the second round?
questions.background: The Open Championship is one of the four major championships in men's professional golf. The halfway leader is the golfer with the lowest cumulative score over the first two rounds.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The R&A's official second-round leaderboard for the 2026 Open Championship, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the golfer occupying outright first place when the second-round standings are finalized, including any applicable scoring penalties.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The golfer's full name.

questions.title: Who will win the middleweight main event at UFC Fight Night in Oklahoma City on July 18, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official UFC results or contemporaneous reporting from reputable news organizations.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the event’s middleweight main event on fight night, excluding any subsequent changes to the result.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning fighter’s full name.

questions.title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the NBA team he chooses.
questions.accepted_format: The full name of the NBA team he chooses.

questions.title: If the Detroit Tigers trade Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline, which team will acquire him?
questions.background: Tarik Skubal is a starting pitcher for the Detroit Tigers and is eligible for free agency after the 2026 season.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official MLB or team announcements, or confirmed reporting from ESPN, identifying a completed trade of Tarik Skubal by the 2026 MLB trade deadline.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the MLB club acquiring Skubal directly from the Detroit Tigers. If no such trade occurs by the deadline, the question is void.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The acquiring club's full team name.
questions.accepted_format: The acquiring club's full team name.
